description: This file contains the implementation of a timer management system within the Orleans framework, including interfaces, classes, and static classes for handling single-shot timers, timer queues, and timer expiration logic.

classes.name: TimerManagerImpl
classes.description: Internal class implementing the ITimerManager interface, providing a Delay method that delegates to the static TimerManager.

classes.name: TimerManager
classes.description: Static class providing timer delay functionalities, including Delay and DelayUntil methods, and internal DelayTimer class.

classes.name: DelayTimer
classes.description: Internal class representing a single-shot timer with completion task, due time, and cancellation handling.

classes.name: TimerManager<T>
classes.description: Generic static class managing timer queues of type T, handling registration, queue checking, and timer expiration logic.

classes.name: ThreadLocalQueue
classes.description: Internal class representing per-thread timer queue with lock, starvation count, head, and tail.

classes.name: ExpiredTimers
classes.description: Internal class managing timers that have expired and need to be fired.

methods.name: Delay
methods.description: Static method in TimerManager that creates a delay task for a specified timespan.

methods.name: DelayUntil
methods.description: Static method in TimerManager that creates a delay task until a specific DateTime.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a timer instance into the appropriate queue.

methods.name: CheckQueues
methods.description: Periodically checks all timer queues for expired timers.

methods.name: CheckQueueInLock
methods.description: Checks a specific queue for timers that have expired or been canceled.

methods.name: EnsureCurrentThreadHasQueue
methods.description: Ensures the current thread has an associated timer queue, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: InitializeThreadLocalQueue
methods.description: Initializes a new thread-local timer queue and registers it in the global collection.

methods.name: FireTimers
methods.description: Fires all timers in the expired timers list, invoking their timeout or canceled handlers.
